Description:

Spørgeskematriagering triagerer besvarelserne i et spørgeskema. Triageringsfarven findes ved at se alle spørgsmålsbesvarelser, og den endelige triagering bliver den højest udslagsgivende farve. Således giver én rød besvarelse rød triagering, og hvis der ingen røde besvarelser er, men mindst en gul besvarelse, bliver triageringsfarven gul. Er der ingen røde eller gule besvarelser, bliver triageringsfarven grøn.

Er der indsendt spørgeskema hvor spørgsmålene ikke er besvaret er triageringsfarven blank. Er der ikke opsat traigeringsindikatorer i spørgeskemaet bliver triageringen blank.
Purpose:

At kunne triagere spørgeskemabesvarelser.
Usage: At kunne triagere spørgeskemabesvarelser.

package rules
import org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.QuestionnaireResponse
import org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Questionnaire
import org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.ServiceRequest
import org.hl7.fhir.r4.context.SimpleWorkerContext
import org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Coding
import org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Type
import com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.ClinicalImpressionDTO
import com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.AnswerSignificanceDTO
import com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.TaskDTO
import com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.CommunicationDTO
import com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.CodingDTO
import com.systematic.ehealth.exception.MismatchedInputException
import com.systematic.ehealth.extensions.EHealthQuestionnaireItemComponentExtension
import com.systematic.ehealth.util.QuestionnaireUtility
import java.util.ArrayList
import java.util.Collection
import java.util.List
import java.util.Collections
import org.apache.commons.collections4.MultiValuedMap
import org.apache.commons.collections4.multimap.ArrayListValuedHashMap;
import com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO
import com.systematic.ehealth.extensions.EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension
import java.util.Map
import org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.BooleanType
import com.systematic.ehealth.extensions.EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerConditionExtension
import org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.DecimalType
import org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.IntegerType
import org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.StringType
import com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.AnswerConditionDTO
import com.systematic.ehealth.exception.RuleExecutionException


global com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.AutomatedProcessingDTO ruleResult


function String getPriorityFromClinicalFinding(CodingDTO clinicalImpressionFinding) {
    switch (clinicalImpressionFinding.getCode()) {
        case "no-answer-significance-defined":
        case "no-effective-answer-significance":
        case "green":
            return "routine";
        case "yellow":
            return "urgent";
        case "red":
            return "asap";
        default:
            return null;
    }
}

function CodingDTO getClinicalImpressionFinding(List findingBasisList) {
    if (findingBasisList.isEmpty()) {
        //Answer significances found, but answers didn't match
        return new CodingDTO("http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/clinicalimpression-finding-codes", "no-effective-answer-significance", "no effective answer significance for answer and question combination");
    }
    boolean yellowAnswerFound = false;

    for (Object findingBasis : findingBasisList) {
        QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO findingBasisDTO = (QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO) findingBasis;
        String significanceCode = findingBasisDTO.getFinding().getCode();
        if (significanceCode.equals("red-question-answer")) {
            //Return early when red question answer is found
            return new CodingDTO("http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/clinicalimpression-finding-codes", "red", "Red overall assessment");
        }

        if (significanceCode.equals("yellow-question-answer")) {
            yellowAnswerFound = true;
        }
    }

    if (yellowAnswerFound) {
        //Can assume we have returned if red question answer was found
        return new CodingDTO("http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/clinicalimpression-finding-codes", "yellow", "Yellow overall assessment");
    }

    //Can assume only green findings, since its not empty, red or yellow.
    //No answer significances, is handled before this function

    return new CodingDTO("http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/clinicalimpression-finding-codes", "green", "Green overall assessment");
}

function boolean containsExistsFalseCondition(EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension answerSignificance) {
    for (EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerConditionExtension condition : answerSignificance.getAnswerConditions()) {
        if (condition.getOperator().hasCode() &&
            condition.getOperator().getCode().equals("exists") &&
            condition.getValue() instanceof BooleanType &&
            !((BooleanType) condition.getValue()).booleanValue()) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

function AnswerSignificanceDTO createAnswerSignificanceFromExtension(EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension extension) {
    AnswerSignificanceDTO dto = new AnswerSignificanceDTO();
    dto.setSignificance(new CodingDTO(extension.getSignificance().getSystem(), extension.getSignificance().getCode(), extension.getSignificance().getDisplay()));
    List<AnswerConditionDTO> conditionDTOs = new ArrayList<>();
    for (EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerConditionExtension condition :  extension.getAnswerConditions()) {
        AnswerConditionDTO conditionDTO = new AnswerConditionDTO();
        if (condition.getValue().getClass().getTypeName().contains("IntegerType")) {
            IntegerType integerValue = (IntegerType) condition.getValue();
            conditionDTO.setValueInteger(integerValue.getValue());
        } else if (condition.getValue().getClass().getTypeName().contains("BooleanType")) {
            BooleanType booleanValue = (BooleanType) condition.getValue();
            conditionDTO.setValueBoolean(booleanValue.getValue());
        } else if (condition.getValue().getClass().getTypeName().contains("DecimalType")) {
            DecimalType decimalValue = (DecimalType) condition.getValue();
            conditionDTO.setValueDecimal(decimalValue.getValue().doubleValue());
        } else if (condition.getValue().getClass().getTypeName().contains("StringType")) {
            StringType stringValue = (StringType) condition.getValue();
            conditionDTO.setValueString(stringValue.getValue());
        } else if (condition.getValue().getClass().getTypeName().contains("Coding")) {
            Coding codingValue = (Coding) condition.getValue();
            conditionDTO.setValueCoding(new CodingDTO(codingValue.getSystem(), codingValue.getCode(), codingValue.getDisplay()));
        }

        conditionDTO.setOperator(condition.getOperator().getCode());
        conditionDTOs.add(conditionDTO);
    }

    dto.setAnswerConditions(conditionDTOs);
    return dto;
}

function CodingDTO createFindingCodingFromAnswerSignificance(EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension answerSignificance) {
    CodingDTO finding = new CodingDTO();
    finding.setSystem("http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/clinicalimpression-finding-codes");

    switch (answerSignificance.getSignificance().getCode()) {
        case "green":
            finding.setCode("green-question-answer");
            finding.setDisplay("green question and answer combination");
            break;
        case "yellow":
            finding.setCode("yellow-question-answer");
            finding.setDisplay("yellow question and answer combination");
            break;
        case "red":
            finding.setCode("red-question-answer");
            finding.setDisplay("red question and answer combination");
            break;
    }

    return finding;
}

function QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO createFindingBasisDTO(String linkId, CodingDTO findingCoding, QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemAnswerComponent answer, AnswerSignificanceDTO answerSignificanceDTO) {
    QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO findingBasisDTO = new QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO();
    findingBasisDTO.setLinkId(linkId);
    findingBasisDTO.setFinding(findingCoding);
    findingBasisDTO.setAnswerSignificance(answerSignificanceDTO);

    if (answer.hasValueBooleanType()) {
        findingBasisDTO.setValueBoolean(answer.getValueBooleanType().booleanValue());
    } else if (answer.hasValueIntegerType()) {
        findingBasisDTO.setValueInteger(answer.getValueIntegerType().getValue());
    } else if (answer.hasValueStringType()) {
        findingBasisDTO.setValueString(answer.getValueStringType().getValueAsString());
    } else if (answer.hasValueDecimalType()) {
        findingBasisDTO.setValueDecimal(answer.getValueDecimalType().getValue().doubleValue());
    } else if (answer.hasValueCoding()) {
        findingBasisDTO.setValueCoding(new CodingDTO(answer.getValueCoding().getSystem(), answer.getValueCoding().getCode(), answer.getValueCoding().getDisplay()));
    }

    return findingBasisDTO;
}

function List getFindingBasisList(MultiValuedMap answerSignificanceMap, MultiValuedMap answerMap) {
    ArrayList<QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO> returnList = new ArrayList<>();

    for (Object entry : answerSignificanceMap.entries()) {
        Map.Entry<String, EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension> questionEntry = (Map.Entry<String, EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension>) entry;
        List<QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemAnswerComponent> answers = (List<QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemAnswerComponent>) answerMap.get(questionEntry.getKey());

        if (containsExistsFalseCondition(questionEntry.getValue())) {
            //Exists false is special case, where we cant loop through answers
            if (!answers.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }
            returnList.add(new QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO(questionEntry.getKey(), createFindingCodingFromAnswerSignificance(questionEntry.getValue()), createAnswerSignificanceFromExtension(questionEntry.getValue())));
        } else {
            //Other operator cases - loop through answers and check against conditions
            for (QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemAnswerComponent answer : answers) {
                if (QuestionnaireUtility.compareAnswerAgainstAnswerSignificance(answer, questionEntry.getValue())) {
                    AnswerSignificanceDTO answerSignificanceDTO = createAnswerSignificanceFromExtension(questionEntry.getValue());
                    CodingDTO findingCoding = createFindingCodingFromAnswerSignificance(questionEntry.getValue());
                    returnList.add(createFindingBasisDTO(questionEntry.getKey(), findingCoding, answer, answerSignificanceDTO));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return returnList;
}

function void gatherLinkedAnswerSignificances(List items, MultiValuedMap answerSignificanceMap) {
    for (Object item : items) {
        List<EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension> answerSignificances = EHealthQuestionnaireItemComponentExtension.getAnswerSignificance(((Questionnaire.QuestionnaireItemComponent) item));
        if (answerSignificances != null) {
            answerSignificanceMap.putAll(((Questionnaire.QuestionnaireItemComponent) item).getLinkId(), answerSignificances);
        }

        gatherLinkedAnswerSignificances(((Questionnaire.QuestionnaireItemComponent) item).getItem(), answerSignificanceMap);
    }
}

function void gatherLinkedAnswerItems(List items, MultiValuedMap answerMap) {
    for (Object item : items) {
        List<QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemAnswerComponent> answers = ((QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemComponent) item).getAnswer();
        if (answers != null) {
            answerMap.putAll(((QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemComponent) item).getLinkId(), answers);
            for (QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemAnswerComponent answer : answers) {
                //Answers have nested items
                gatherLinkedAnswerItems(answer.getItem(), answerMap);
            }
        }

        //Items have nested items
        gatherLinkedAnswerItems(((QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemComponent) item).getItem(), answerMap);
    }
}

function ClinicalImpressionDTO createClinicalImpression(String description, CodingDTO clinicalImpressionFinding, String priority, List basisFindings) {
    CodingDTO clinicalImpressionCode = new CodingDTO("http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/clinicalimpression-codes", "TriagingResult", "Result of triaging");
    ClinicalImpressionDTO clinicalImpressionDTO = new ClinicalImpressionDTO(clinicalImpressionCode, description, Collections.singletonList(clinicalImpressionFinding), List.of());
    clinicalImpressionDTO.setFindingBasis(basisFindings);

    //Determine if triage happened
    boolean isResponseTriaged = true;
    if (clinicalImpressionFinding.getCode().equals("no-effective-answer-significance") || clinicalImpressionFinding.getCode().equals("no-answer-significance-defined")) {
        isResponseTriaged = false;
    }

    //Task
    CodingDTO taskCategory;
    if (isResponseTriaged) {
        taskCategory = new CodingDTO("http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/task-category", "MeasurementForAssessment", "Need assessment of measurement");
    } else {
        taskCategory = new CodingDTO("http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/task-category", "MeasurementForAssessmentNotTriaged", "Need assessment of measurement where triage was not performed during automated processing");
    }
    CodingDTO restrictionCategory = new CodingDTO("http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/restriction-category", "measurement-monitoring", "Monitoring of measurement(s)");
    TaskDTO task = new TaskDTO(taskCategory, "Spørgeskemabesvarelse til evaluering", priority, Collections.singletonList(restrictionCategory), Collections.emptyList());
    clinicalImpressionDTO.setTasks(Collections.singletonList(task));

    return clinicalImpressionDTO;
}

function void throwMismatchedInputException(String ruleDescription, String focus) {
    throw new MismatchedInputException(ruleDescription, focus);
}

rule "QuestionnaireResponseTriageOnAnswerSignificance"
dialect "java"
    when
        $qrs : Collection()
        $listQrs : ArrayList() from collect (QuestionnaireResponse() from $qrs)
        $questionnaire : Questionnaire()
        $serviceRequest : ServiceRequest()
    then
        if ($listQrs.isEmpty()) {
            throwMismatchedInputException("Manglende input. Forventede én spørgeskemabesvarelse", $serviceRequest.getId());
        }
        if ($listQrs.size() > 1) {
            throwMismatchedInputException("Flere input. Forventede én spørgeskemabesvarelse", $serviceRequest.getId());
        }
        QuestionnaireResponse qr = (QuestionnaireResponse)$listQrs.get(0);

        MultiValuedMap<String, EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension> answerSignificanceMap = new ArrayListValuedHashMap<>();
        MultiValuedMap<String, QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemAnswerComponent> answerMap = new ArrayListValuedHashMap<>();
        gatherLinkedAnswerSignificances($questionnaire.getItem(), answerSignificanceMap);
        gatherLinkedAnswerItems(qr.getItem(), answerMap);

        CodingDTO clinicalImpressionFinding;
        List<QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO> findingBasisList = Collections.emptyList();

        if (answerSignificanceMap.isEmpty() || answerSignificanceMap.values().isEmpty()) {
            clinicalImpressionFinding = new CodingDTO("http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/clinicalimpression-finding-codes", "no-answer-significance-defined", "no answer significance defined for question(s)");
        } else {
            findingBasisList = getFindingBasisList(answerSignificanceMap, answerMap);
            clinicalImpressionFinding = getClinicalImpressionFinding(findingBasisList);
        }

        String priority = getPriorityFromClinicalFinding(clinicalImpressionFinding);
        ruleResult.setClinicalImpressions(Collections.singletonList(createClinicalImpression(null, clinicalImpressionFinding, priority, findingBasisList)));
end;
